title: Servicii de control prin teledetecţie a cererilor de sprijin depuse de către fermieri pentru anii de cerere 2020 si 2021"-Lot 1 si Lot 2
description: Agentia de Plati si Interventie pentru Agricultura (APIA) a demarat o procedura de achizitie pentru atribuirea unui acord cadru de „Servicii de control prin teledetecţie a cererilor de sprijin depuse de către fermieri pentru anii de cerere 2020 si 2021"-Lot 1 si Lot 2. Agenţia de Plăţi şi Intervenţie pentru Agricultură (APIA) este instituţia publică din România care gestionează plăţile pentru o serie de scheme de sprijin finanţate din Fondul European de Garantare Agricolă (FEGA) și Fondul European pentru Dezvoltare Rurală (FEADR) legate de sprijinul pe suprafaţă. O condiţie esenţială pentru acordarea subvenţiilor legate de plăţile directe pe suprafaţă este crearea unui sistem care să asigure administrarea şi controlul riguros al cererilor de plată ale fermierilor, iar verificarea corectitudinii solicitărilor de plată se realizează prin compararea datelor declarate de fermieri cu o serie de date de referinţă stocate în bazele de date ale sistemului informatic propriu. Suma plăţilor directe acordate unui fermier depinde în mod direct de suprafaţa de teren utilizată de acesta. Statele membre ale Uniunii Europene, în cooperare cu Comisia Europeană, utilizează teledetecţia pentru a controla cel puţin o parte din suprafeţele agricole subvenţionate din fonduri europene, fiecare stat membru fiind responsabil de desfăşurarea acestei activităţi pe teritoriul său. În conformitate cu Regulamentul Consiliului (CE) nr. 1306/2013, Regulamentul de punere în aplicare (CE) nr. 809/2014, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, coroborat cu documentul de lucru DSCG/2014/32 pentru verificările pe teren (OTSC) și măsurarea suprafeței în conformitate cu art. 24, 25, 26, 27, 30, 31, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41 din Regulamentul (UE) nr. 809/2014 și Specificațiile Tehnice Comune CTS pentru efectuarea controalelor pe teren emise de DG AGRI - JRC, APIA a decis să folosească, pe lângă controlul prin măsurători clasice pe teren, controlul prin teledetecţie pentru controlul cererilor de sprijin depuse de către fermieri. Astfel numărul maxim estimat de fermieri ce vor putea fi controlați prin teledetecţie este de cca. 95.000, suprafaţa propusă pentru controlul prin teledetecţie aferentă anului de cerere 2020/2021 este de aproximativ 29400 km2, zona de control fiind structurată pe 35 zone separate (site-uri) amplasate pe întreg teritoriul României și divizate în 2 loturi, după cum urmează: LOT I: AB_20; AG_20; BH_20; BN_20;; CJ_20; CS_20; DJ_20; HD_20; MH_20; MM_20; MS_20; OT_20; SB_20; SJ_20; SM_20; TM_20; TR_20; VL_20 LOT II: BC_20; BR_20;BT_20; BV_20; CL_20; CT_20; CV_20; GL_20; GR_20; HR_20; IL_20; IS_20; PH_20; SV_20; TL_20;; VN_20; VS_20 Descrierea detaliata a serviciilor care se solicita a fi realizate, precum și cerințele tehnice ale serviciilor, sunt prezentate în Specificaţiile tehnice pentru Servicii de control prin teledetecţie a cererilor de sprijin depuse de către fermieri pentru anii de cerere 2020 și 2021. Durata acordului-cadru: Durata în luni: 24 de luni. Acordul cadru se va încheia cu un singur operator economic pentru fiecare lot in parte. Calendarul estimativ de aplicare a procedurii de atribuire a acordului-cadru: Se estimeaza ca Acordul-cadru se va aplica în perioada: iulie 2020 - iulie 2022. Estimam ca se vor atribui câte 2 de contracte subsecvente pe an, pentru fiecare lot in parte Descrierea detaliata a serviciilor care se solicita a fi realizate, precum și cerințele tehnice ale serviciilor, sunt prezentate în Specificaţiile tehnice pentru Servicii de control prin teledetecţie a cererilor de sprijin depuse de către fermieri pentru anii de cerere 2020 și 2021. Operatorii economici pot solicita clarificări cu un număr de 16 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractantă va elabora şi posta în SICAP răspunsul la toate solicitările de clarificări depuse în termenul de mai sus, în a 11-a zi înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor .

title: SUSTAINABLE MINERAL RESOURCES MANAGEMENT - EXPRO+
description: Sustainable mineral resource management involves the responsible extraction, use, and conservation of mineral resources to meet present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. It emphasizes efficient mining practices, minimizing environmental impacts, and restoring ecosystems after extraction. An important component of this approach is the use of Earth observation technologies, which allow the detection of (critical earth) minerals, continuous monitoring of mining activities, land degradation and water quality. The development of novel EO solutions and tools improve transparency, support better decision-making, andhelp detect unsustainable practices in near real time. Combined with recycling, resource efficiency, and strong environmental policies, Earth observation enhances the ability to balance economic development with environmental protection and social responsibility,ensuring long-term sustainability of mineral resources.

Alimentatorul inclus in pachet Splitterul HDMI 2.0 Signal-HD 1x4 H3215 permite conectarea a 4 televizoare sau monitoare cu intrare HDMI la o singură sursă de semnal HD. Semnalele amplificare pot fi transmise prin cabluri HDMI 2.0 pe distanțe de până la 15 m. Produsul este ideal pentru zone de pretentare a televizoarelor HD și 4K (rezoluții de până la 4k x 2k @ 60 Hz) sau alte echipamente HD în magazine sau prezentări de produse. Acesta poate fi folosit și în săli de clasă sau săli de conferințe pentru a splita semnalul HDMI de la un calculator la două proiectoare. Datorită posibilităţii utilizării unui cablu HDMI lung (chiar până la 15 m), acesta se va putea masca uşor în cazul instalării televizorului pe perete folosind un suport LCD/plasmă. Aspectul estetic se va îmbunătăţii considerabil. title: RV Online-Kommunikation (Beratungs-, Konzeptions-, Design-, Marketing- & Redaktionsleistungen)
description: Das Bayerische Staatsministerium für Wirtschaft, Landesentwicklung und Energie (StMWi) verfügt über ein umfangreiches Online-Angebot zu einer Vielzahl von Themen mit großer inhaltlicher Tiefe. Die Webseite stmwi.bayern.de ist die Hauptseite des Ministeriums. Sie stellt die Visitenkarte des Bayerischen Wirtschaftsministeriums dar und bündelt sämtliche Aktivitäten und Informationen zu den wirtschaftspolitischen Kernthemen. Zusätzlich betreibt das StMWi zahlreiche Satellitenseiten wie z.B. Image- und Kampagnenseiten oder Fach- und Themenportale (vgl. Webseitenarchitektur des StMWi, abrufbar unter https://www.stmwi.bayern.de/impressum/). Das Portfolio umfasst Online-Auftritte zu (wirtschafts-)politischen Schwerpunktthemen wie Außenwirtschaft, Existenz- und Gründungsförderung, Energiewende, Landesentwicklung, Aus- und Weiterbildung, zu Förderprogrammen (z.B. Digitalbonus Bayern, Mobilfunk Bayern) und Wettbewerben (z.B. Innovationspreis Bayern) sowie zu Veranstaltungen. Neben Webseiten betreibt das StMWi Social-Media-Kanäle (z.B. Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, TikTok und YouTube). Daneben setzt das StMWi weitere Instrumente der On-line-Kommunikation wie E-Mail- und Newsletter-Marketing (z.B. Gründerland Bayern, Pressenewsletter), Suchmaschinenmarketing (SEO/GEO und SEA), Content-Marketing (z.B. Erfolgreich-handeln-Kampagne) und Influencer-Kampagnen ein. Die Dachmarkenstrategie des StMWi präsentiert die Aktivitäten der Online-Kommunikation als Einheit mit deutlichem Wiedererkennungswert. Die Ministeriumswebseite stmwi.bayern.de ist grafisch, technisch und inhaltlich gemäß dem Online-Styleguide des StMWi und den Corporate Design-Vorgaben der Bayerischen Staatsregierung gestaltet (vgl. Online-Styleguide des StMWi und Corporate Design Manual, abrufbar unter https://www.stmwi.bayern.de/design/). Im Sinne einer ganzheitlichen Markenführung basieren sämtliche Satellitenseiten des StMWi auf den Online-Designvorgaben des Ministeriums. Die Online-Kommunikation des StMWi ist integraler Bestandteil der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit des Ministeriums. Um dem Informationsauftrag staatlicher Öffentlichkeitsarbeit gerecht zu werden, müssen die Aktivitäten und Kompetenzen des StMWi zielgruppen- und themenspezifisch kommuniziert werden. Im Sinne einer modernen User Experience müssen die Inhalte der Online-Kommunikation visuell ansprechend, interaktiv und ganzheitlich aufbereitet werden. Daher müssen die Webseiten und weiteren Instrumente der Online-Kommunikation des StMWi permanent weiterentwickelt werden. Hierfür wird ein externer Dienstleister benötigt. Details zum Leistungsumfang sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen.

title: Purchase of Eddy Covariance System for continuous measurements of CO₂, H₂O and CH₄ fluxes
description: DTU requires the acquisition of one complete eddy covariance measurement station for continuous, long-term monitoring of exchanges of carbon dioxide (CO₂), methane (CH₄), water vapour, heat, and momentum between an apple orchard and the atmosphere. The system will be used for research on climate impacts, greenhouse gas balances, carbon sequestration, water use, and sustainable agricultural production. The acquisition comprises a fully integrated field measurement station capable of operating autonomously under outdoor conditions throughout the year and generating high-frequency measurements suitable for eddy covariance flux calculations. The acquisition includes: • 1 three-dimensional sonic anemometer for high-frequency measurement of wind speed and wind direction. • 1 open-path carbon dioxide and water vapour analyser for continuous measurement of atmospheric CO₂ and H₂O concentrations. • 1 open-path methane analyser for continuous measurement of atmospheric CH₄ concentrations. • 1 integrated data acquisition, processing, storage, and communication system for synchronization, logging, quality control, and transfer of measurement data. • 1 meteorological measurement package comprising sensors for air temperature, relative humidity, precipitation, solar radiation, photosynthetically active radiation (PAR), net radiation, soil moisture, soil temperature, and soil heat flux. • 1 backup power and data retention system to ensure continued operation and prevent data loss during temporary interruptions. • 1 software package for data processing, quality assurance, visualization, footprint analysis, gap filling, and management of eddy covariance data. • 1 galvanized lattice measurement tower with a height of approximately 12 m, including foundation, mounting hardware, transport, and installation. The tower is required to position sensors above the orchard canopy and provide safe access for installation and maintenance. • 1 solar power system comprising photovoltaic panels, batteries, charge controller, mounting hardware, cabling, and associated electrical components required for autonomous operation at a field site without permanent grid connection. • All cables, communication equipment, sensor mounts, brackets, connectors, and accessories required for a complete operational system. DTU requires a complete Eddy Covariance system for continuous measurement of ecosystematmosphere exchanges of carbon dioxide (CO₂), water vapour (H₂O), methane (CH₄) and energy in an experimental apple orchard. The system must provide high-frequency measurements, robust long-term field operation, standardized data processing and compatibility with established international flux research infrastructures. A market assessment was performed to identify suppliers capable of delivering a complete Eddy Covariance solution that meets the scientific and technical requirements of the project. Suppliers investigated included LI-COR Biosciences, Campbell Scientific, Picarro and Los Gatos Research. Several suppliers can provide systems for CO₂ and H₂O flux measurements. However, LI-COR is the only supplier identified that can provide the required integrated Eddy Covariance platform including an open-path methane analyser, synchronized measurement architecture, integrated real-time flux processing and established compatibility with major international flux monitoring networks. The proposed system includes the LI-7700 open-path methane analyser integrated with the LI-7900 EddyFlux platform. According to the supplier documentation, LI-COR is the only supplier offering an open-path methane Eddy Covariance system with extensive field validation and long-term scientific use. The system further provides microsecond-level synchronization of instruments through Precision Time Protocol (PTP) and GPS-based clock control, which are essential for accurate flux calculations and data consistency. The system includes EddyPro, a widely adopted Eddy Covariance processing software used by international research infrastructures and flux networks, including ICOS. The software environment, data handling capabilities and compatibility with established network requirements are essential for ensuring data quality, comparability and long-term usability of the measurements generated within the project. The Eddy Covariance tower will be installed as temporary research infrastructure and will be dismantled and relocated to other research sites upon completion of the project. The tower and instrumentation therefore constitute reusable scientific infrastructure. Based on the market assessment, no reasonable alternative supplier was identified that could provide an equivalent integrated solution meeting all technical requirements for open-path methane Eddy Covariance measurements, synchronization, processing and compatibility with international flux research infrastructures and DTU therefore intends to award the contract to LI-COR Biosciences GmbH. title: GT17-683SD ROBUST ATTITUDE UNCERTAINTY ESTIMATION FOR DEBRIS REMOVAL (EXPRO+)
description: Active debris removal (ADR) and in-orbit servicing (IOS) missions rely on spacecraft attitude information. Attitude motion estimates are key drivers for selecting removal targets and for the planning of removal missions (e.g. close proximity operations) and the design of the spacecraft (e.g. the capturing mechanism).Attitude states are currently determined from optical light curves, laser ranging residuals and radar imaging. Novel approaches must be explored to get a more comprehensive picture, e.g. using RCS time series, diffusely scattered laser returns and data from photon counting devices. Current tools and algorithms do not estimate the uncertainty associated to the determined attitude state. This information is crucial for the derivation of safety marginsand operational procedures for rendezvous and capture. Uncertainty estimates further allow data fusion of observations from different sources with complementary information content, which increases the overall confidence in the obtained solution.The goal is to develop an attitude and uncertainty determination algorithm for objects with and without a-priori knowledge (e.g. a method based on diffusely reflected laser pulses, retroreflector array signature of laser ranging residuals, light curve simulation and fitting using geometric models for well-known targets), or alternative approaches assuming simplified shapes for other targets. The algorithm shallconsider novel measurement types and account for uncertainties caused by model inaccuracies/simplifications and by input observation uncertainties. Iterative improvement methods (e.g. sequential filters) shall be studied to model complex attitude dynamic evolution (e.g. nutation and precession of spin axis direction), to reduce the search space and therefore uncertainty region when acquiring new observational data. To validate the developed algorithms, it is fundamental to enhance the performances of the attitude simulation software considering new sensor and measurement types.

title: Study on the Risks of Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Fraud Inherent in the Union Registry and Data Protection Impact Assessment
description: The EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) is a cornerstone of the European Union's policy to combat climate change and is its key tool for reducing industrial greenhouse gas emissions. It covers more than 11 000 power stations, industrial plants and aircraft operators in 31 countries. The Union Registry and the European Union Transaction Log (EUTL) track the ownership of allowances by recording the amounts owned in the accounts and the transactions between accounts.The general objective of this study is to assess the risks related to fraud, money laundering and terrorist financing inherent in the EU ETS and the Union Registry, to propose mitigation measures for the identified risks and to perform a data protection impact assessment in case the implementation of the proposed measures would require that.

title: Servicii de asist. si mentenanta software Registrul Agricol
description:
Servicii informatice de asistenta tehnica, mentenanta si suport operational CENTROREG - program pentru registrul agricol,. Programul pentru registrul agricol cuprinde toate datele din registrele agricole ale comunei privind proprietăţile şi modul de utilizare a acestora atât pentru persoane fizice cât şi pentru persoane juridice. Cu ajutorul acestei aplicaţii pentru registrul agricol se pot obţine situaţii privind: proprietatea unei persoane (un rol sau poziţie din registru), un indicator pentru o persoană, pentru mai multe persoane, pentru un sat, componenţa gospodăriilor, modul de utilizare a terenurilor, suprafaţa arabilă, cu pomi fructiferi, efectivul de animale, etc. Se obţin centralizatoare pe proprietari, pe sate şi comună pentru toţi indicatorii din registru. Se emit adeverinţele solicitate de persoanele cu rol în baza de date a registrului. Toate informatiile existente in cadrul sistemului de gestiune a registrelor agricole sunt corelate cu informatiile si datele existente in sistemul de gestiune a taxelor si impozitelor locale, cum ar fi informatiile legate de persoane, adresele lor, terenurile, suprafetele, cladirile, si utilajele. Sistemul informatic permite gestiunea schitelor gospodariilor (parcele, cladiri, etc) prin intermediul unei platforme integrate de tip GIS.Schitele sunt expuse in diverse formate, cum ar fi WMS, WMTS, etc, si sunt afisate in cadrul aplicatiei printr-o componenta dedicata.
